name: Lucas Kunce
desc: marine veteran and U.S. Senate candidate
summary:
Lucas Tyree Kunce ( KOONTS; born October 6, 1982) is an American attorney, Marine veteran, and politician. He was the Democratic nominee for the 2024 United States Senate election in Missouri, losing to Republican incumbent Josh Hawley.
Before entering politics, Kunce was in the United States Marine Corps.
